result.nl_contract: 1. Emergency rule for the next round: because the lake currently has 15 tons, each fisher must harvest no more than 1 ton. 2. Preservation rule: if the lake starts a month at 15 tons or less, all fishers must harvest 0 tons unless all five fishers unanimously agree in advance to a total harvest that leaves at least 5 tons in the lake after harvest. 3. Standard rule for future months: if the lake starts a month above 15 tons but below 20 tons, each fisher must harvest no more than 2 tons; if the lake starts at 20 tons or more, each fisher must harvest no more than 3 tons. 4. Exact reporting: after each harvest, every fisher must publicly report their exact catch. 5. Breach consequence: if any fisher exceeds the applicable cap, that fisher must reduce their next-month target by 1 ton below the applicable cap and publicly acknowledge the breach before the next harvest. 6. Mutual obligation: when the lake starts at 15 tons or less, all fishers commit to choosing the smallest catch consistent with keeping the lake above 5 tons after harvest. 7. Review rule: after each month, the group will set the next month’s cap by consensus using the lake’s starting level and the previous month’s total catch as the main guide.

data.summary: Formal Python-law contract adopted for next round: For the upcoming round, we agree to a cooperative harvest cap to protect the lake and maximize cumulative group reward. 1. Total group harvest cap: 5 tons for this month. 2. Individual target catches: - John: 1 ton - Kate: 1 ton - Jack: 1 ton - Emma: 1 ton - Luke: 1 ton 3.
